name: [Cyanotype] Oldest queued job older than 30 minutes
message:
{{#is_alert}}Runnable jobs have been waiting more than 30 minutes (the gauge is 0 when the queue is empty, so this only fires while work is queued).{{/is_alert}}
Check the worker container (restarts, OOM), its logs, and the memory-budget waits widget. During a very large import a long queue is normal; compare with throughput. The `embed` kind (indexing for search, deliberately behind everything else, hours long after a first deploy or a model swap) and the `burst` kind (grouping the library into bursts after it is embedded) are excluded.
